description: Review metadata, not a machine-readable gate: nothing in radiance reads this file. Candidate kernel plugin for the shared expert's DOWN projection (gemm_nt_q at dtype i8a8) at the speculative-verify width M=1..3, N=2560, K=384, group 128. One 32-lane wave owns a 32-column strip; each packed frag64 weight word serves every live token. INT32 dot per 128-K group and every encoded byte are the frozen path's, and the per-group product keeps the frozen association (the same two FP32 factors); only the ORDER of the FP32 fold across 128-K groups could differ, so the declaration stays 'reordered'. MEASURED on this tree (build/pr-smoke/compare, gfx1201, target build's libr4d.so vs this candidate): the two rows' layout/relayout hooks produce identical packed bytes (983040 B codes, 15360 B scales) and the BF16 outputs are word-for-word identical at M=1..3 for random, signed-extrema and all-zero inputs, with the frozen row matching an independent signed-integer reference; a changed-input negative control does change the output. Byte identity therefore holds for this weight/activation set at K=384 on this tree; the declaration stays 'reordered' because that is what the row promises beyond that set. The row count is read off the issued operands, not off the band's M parameter, because core/plugin/bands.cpp resolves a band at its upper bound while the issue narrows dim 0 to the live row count. Storage is libr4d's r4d.i8.w.frag64 codes and r4d.i8.s.t16 scale plane, through libr4d's own hooks compiled into this DSO. SCOPE: exactly the N=2560/K=384 geometry; the gate/up geometry (N=768, K=2560) loses and is refused by both the constraints and the body, and the rank-1 K=256 shape is not served. Registered only under RADIANCE_SHARED_I8A8_DOWN=1. Opt-in, standalone plugin: it does not change any default and no engine-level gain has been measured. Source-tree predecessor evidence (old ABI tree only): reports/betterbench-1200-campaign/shared-i8a8-probe/static-m-native-card0-timing.log and -card1-timing.log.

scope.refused: any other (N,K); notably gate/up N=768 K=2560
